Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Palantir Foundry Developer to support the design, development, and optimization of data workflows and automation within the Palantir Foundry platform. This role is ideal for early‑career developers or data engineers who are eager to grow their technical skills, work with cutting‑edge data technologies, and contribute to high‑impact business outcomes.

Responsibilities
Build and maintain data pipelines in Palantir Foundry, covering ingestion, transformation, and integration of complex datasets
Design data models and ontology structures that support data quality, lineage, and interoperability
Write efficient Python, SQL, and Spark code to power custom transforms and workflows
Build and manage LLM-powered workflows and agents using Palantir AIP
Translate business and operational requirements from cross-functional stakeholders into working Foundry solutions
Support development of dashboards, data applications, and front-end interfaces for end users
Contribute to ETL design, testing, and maintenance across cloud-based data environments
Assist in integrating new data sources, ensuring high data quality and reliability
Help automate ingestion, transformation, and validation processes.
Your Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar)
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related technical role
2+ years of hands‑on experience in Palantir Foundry or another advanced data platform at enterprise scale.
Strong proficiency in SQL — complex queries, data modeling, relational database design
Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation and pipeline development
Hands-on familiarity with Palantir Foundry and Palantir AIP
Some exposure to front-end design or UI development
Experience with TypeScript for front-end or application-layer development
Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Databricks
Experience building Foundry Ontologies, OTs, Code Repositories, and operational applications
Knowledge of micro-services, REST APIs, and event‑driven architectures
Effective communication skills in a cross-functional, client-facing environment
Ability to collaborate with executive-level stakeholders and articulate technical concepts clearly
Strong problem‑solving mindset with attention to detail
Bonus If You Have
Experience in HR system integrations
